         ANTHRACOKALI

       Anthracite Coal Dissolved in Boiling Caustic Potash

      (ANTHRAKOKALI)


Useful in skin affections, scabies, prurigo, chronic herpes, cracks and
      ulcerations. Papular-like eruption with a vesicular tendency, especially on scrotum, also on
      hands, tibia, shoulders and dorsum of feet. Intense thirst. Chronic rheumatism. Bilious
      attacks, vomiting of bile, tympanic distention of abdomen.



Dose.--  Low triturations.
